A reef knot, also known as a square knot, is a simple binding knot used to secure a rope or line around an object. It is formed by tying a left-handed overhand knot and then a right-handed overhand knot, commonly summarized as "left over right, right over left."

While it is easy to tie and lays flat, it is not reliable for joining two ropes of different thicknesses or for critical safety loads, as it can slip or capsize under tension.

Would you like me to find a guide on how to tie one?
